description: Check an existing e-invoice: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF (base64) or XML (CII or UBL, including XRechnung). Runs the official KoSIT validator, Mustang (EN 16931 rules) and, for PDFs, the PDF/A check. Returns overall_pass, verdict, kosit_result, pdfa_compliant and findings with rule ids such as BR-CO-15 and their messages. Checks format and rules only, not tax correctness. Read-only, nothing is stored, no API key needed. Keywords: E-Rechnung prüfen, XRechnung validieren, ZUGFeRD validator, Factur-X check.

content.description: The e-invoice: a base64-encoded PDF (ZUGFeRD/Factur-X) when content_format is pdf_b64, or the XML text itself (CII or UBL, including XRechnung) when it is xml.
content.title: Content

content_format.description: pdf_b64 (default) for a base64 PDF, xml for raw XML text.
